text: おれの　ポケモン　レベル　あげても　ぜんぜん　しんか　しないぜえ！

structure.en: even when I raise their levels

structure.jp: ぜんぜん　しんか　しないぜえ！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus も means 'even if' or 'even when'. レベル　あげても = 'even when I raise their levels'.

patterns.name: ぜんぜん〜ない
patterns.span: ぜんぜん　しんか　しない
patterns.explanation: ぜんぜん with a 'not' verb means 'not at all'. ぜんぜん　しんか　しない = 'don't evolve at all'.
